name: CrabCraft Bot
author: ops@crabcraftmc.com
description: Crabby — the CrabCraft Discord bot. Built on Bun + discord.js. The install script clones the CrabCraft monorepo, installs dependencies, and bundles the Infisical CLI. On each start, pterodactyl/start.sh logs into Infisical with a machine identity (universal auth) and runs the bot via `infisical run` so that all secrets (Discord token, database URLs, API keys) are injected from your Infisical project. Discord role/channel IDs are synced from panel variables into apps/bot/config.json. Set AUTO_UPDATE=1 to git fetch + reinstall on every restart.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# CrabCraft Bot - Pterodactyl install script
set -e

echo "==> CrabCraft Bot install starting"

apt -y update
apt -y install --no-install-recommends git curl ca-certificates gnupg unzip

GIT_URL="${GIT_REPO_URL:-https://github.com/CrabCraftMC/CrabCraft.git}"
GIT_REF="${GIT_REF:-main}"

echo "==> Repo: ${GIT_URL}"
echo "==> Ref:  ${GIT_REF}"

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ -d ".git" ]; then
    echo "==> Refreshing existing checkout"
    git remote set-url origin "${GIT_URL}"
    git fetch --depth 1 origin "${GIT_REF}"
    git reset --hard FETCH_HEAD
    git clean -fd -e node_modules -e .local
else
    echo "==> Cloning fresh"
    tmpdir="$(mktemp -d)"
    git clone --branch "${GIT_REF}" --depth 1 "${GIT_URL}" "${tmpdir}"
    shopt -s dotglob
    cp -r "${tmpdir}/." /mnt/server/
    rm -rf "${tmpdir}"
fi

echo "==> Installing Bun (temporary, for dependency install)"
export BUN_INSTALL="/tmp/bun"
curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
export PATH="${BUN_INSTALL}/bin:${PATH}"
bun --version

echo "==> Installing dependencies"
bun install --frozen-lockfile --production

echo "==> Installing Infisical CLI"
curl -1sLf 'https://artifacts-cli.infisical.com/setup.deb.sh' | bash
apt-get update
apt-get install -y infisical
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.local/bin
cp "$(command -v infisical)" /mnt/server/.local/bin/infisical
chmod +x /mnt/server/.local/bin/infisical
/mnt/server/.local/bin/infisical --version

if [ ! -s apps/bot/config.json ] || ! grep -q '"roles"' apps/bot/config.json; then
    echo "==> Seeding apps/bot/config.json"
    cat > apps/bot/config.json <<'JSON'
{
  "roles": { "member": "", "mod": "", "live": "" },
  "channels": {
    "applicationCategory": "",
    "log": "",
    "leaderboard": "",
    "wiki": "",
    "starboard": "",
    "counting": "",
    "ticketCategory": ""
  }
}
JSON
fi

if [ -f pterodactyl/start.sh ]; then
    chmod +x pterodactyl/start.sh
else
    echo "WARNING: pterodactyl/start.sh not found in repo; the server will fail to start." >&2
fi

echo "==> Install complete"

variables.name: Infisical Client ID
variables.description: Machine identity client ID from Infisical (Universal Auth). Find under Project → Access Control → Machine Identities.

variables.name: Infisical Client Secret
variables.description: Machine identity client secret paired with the client ID above. Treat as a secret.

variables.name: Infisical Project ID
variables.description: Infisical project ID (a.k.a. workspace ID) that holds the bot's secrets.

variables.name: Infisical Environment
variables.description: Environment slug to pull secrets from (e.g. prod, staging, dev).

variables.name: Infisical Domain (self-hosted)
variables.description: Optional. Base URL for a self-hosted Infisical instance (e.g. https://infisical.example.com). Leave blank to use Infisical Cloud (https://app.infisical.com).

variables.name: Member Role ID
variables.description: Discord role ID for verified members. Required.

variables.name: Mod Role ID
variables.description: Discord role ID for moderators. Required.

variables.name: Live Role ID
variables.description: Optional. Role applied to members who are currently live-streaming.

variables.name: Application Category ID
variables.description: Discord category ID where application channels are created. Required.

variables.name: Log Channel ID
variables.description: Discord channel ID for moderation/audit logs. Required.

variables.name: Ticket Category ID
variables.description: Discord category ID where support tickets are created. Required.

variables.name: Leaderboard Channel ID
variables.description: Optional. Channel where the live leaderboard message is posted.

variables.name: Wiki Channel ID
variables.description: Optional. Channel where wiki change updates are posted.

variables.name: Starboard Channel ID
variables.description: Optional. Channel where starred messages are reposted.

variables.name: Counting Channel ID
variables.description: Optional. Channel where the counting game runs.

variables.name: Git Repository URL
variables.description: Git URL to clone/pull the CrabCraft monorepo from. Change only if you maintain a fork.

variables.name: Git Ref (branch/tag/sha)
variables.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA to check out. Defaults to main.

variables.name: Auto-update on restart
variables.description: When 1, git-fetch the configured ref and reinstall dependencies on every start. Set to 0 to pin the running version.
